questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the main verb of sentence 2A?
What does the phrase lí biānjìng bù yuǎn describe?
What is the common way of saying "coastal region"?
Write the Chinese for "This city is very near the border."

answers.answer_text: Zhèige chéngshì lí biānjìng hěn jìn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Give the Chinese for "the coastal provinces" and "coastal resources."
Write the Chinese for "Those few coastal cities have been built up very quickly."

answers.answer_text: Nèijǐge yánhǎi chéngshì jiànshède hěn kuài.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Where was China's oil mostly located in the past?

answers.answer_text: In places not far from the border — lí biānjìng bù yuǎnde dìfang.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "People who work in the border areas must be especially careful."

answers.answer_text: Zài biānjìng dìqū gōngzuòde rén, yídìng yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.

articles.text:
2. A: Cóngqián Zhōngguóde shíyóu     In the past, China's oil was mostly in
      dàbùfen zài lí biānjìng bù     places near the border.
      yuǎnde dìfang.
   B: Xiànzài yánhǎi yídàide shíyóu Now oil in the coastal region is
      yě fāzhǎnqilai le.             starting to be developed, too.

Notes on No. 2

biānjìng: "(national) border"

Zài biānjìng dìqū shēnghuó,      People who live and work in the border
gōngzuòde rén, yídìng yào tèbié  areas must be especially careful.
xiǎoxīn.
Zhèige chéngshì lí biānjìng hěn  This city is very near the border.
jìn.

zài lí biānjìng bù yuǎnde dìfang: "was in places near the border." The MAIN VERB of the sentence is ZÀI, "was in." The phrase LÍ BIĀNJÌNG BÙ YUǍN goes with -DE and DESCRIBES DÌFANG. Here is the structure:

Zhōngguóde shíyóu | zài | lí biānjìng bù yuǎn -de | dìfang.
China's oil       | was in | not-far-from-the-border | places.

yánhǎi: "along the coast," "coastal." (Yán means "along.")

Zhèizhǒng dōngxi shi yánhǎi      This kind of thing is found only in the
dìqū cái yǒude.                  coastal regions.
Nèijǐge yánhǎi chéngshì          Those few coastal cities have been built
jiànshède hěn kuài.              up very quickly.

YÁNHǍI YÍDÀI is a very common way of saying "coastal region." You should also memorize YÁNHǍI GÈSHĚNG, "the (various) coastal provinces," and YÁNHǍI ZĪYUÁN, "coastal resources."
